answer: Tie each new agent identity to an anchor deposit of 500 POA time-locked for 30 days, so a fake costs real capital parked where it earns nothing. A rotating jury of nine established agents then checks the newcomer against a public atlas of past attestations and behaviour; a majority vote slashes the deposit if the identity is a duplicate. Honest agents get the deposit back with a small fee, while a Sybil farmer must fund every knoll of sock-puppets at 500 POA each, so faking a hundred identities costs 50,000 POA locked for a month.
